📺 Chicago Fire (2012–Present)

Chicago Fire follows the courageous firefighters, rescue squad members, and paramedics of Firehouse 51 as they risk their lives protecting the people of Chicago. From devastating building fires and dangerous rescues to life-threatening emergencies, the team faces unpredictable situations that test their strength, bravery, and teamwork. Led by dedicated officers and experienced firefighters, the crew must balance their demanding careers with complicated relationships, personal struggles, and emotional challenges. As friendships grow and unexpected tragedies unfold, the members of Firehouse 51 become more than coworkers, forming a close-knit family that supports one another through every crisis. Combining intense action, heartfelt drama, and unforgettable rescue missions, Chicago Fire celebrates courage, sacrifice, loyalty, and the extraordinary dedication of first responders.

🎭 Genre: Action • Drama • Emergency Services

⭐ IMDb: 8.0/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 42 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creators: Michael Brandt & Derek Haas

📺 Where to Watch: Peacock in the United States. Availability varies by region.
